title: 環境材料学
subtitle: Environmental Materials
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1) gain basic knowledge concerning materials science in order to design, construct, and maintain infrastructure appropriately while considering the environment of the region and the earth.
(2) learn features of cement concrete, steel, and asphalt, which are primary construction materials.
(3) learn methods for designing the mixture proportion of cement concrete.
advice:
This is a basic course on construction materials. We will cover the following topics:

1. Features and classification of construction materials
2. Materials science: Chemical, electrical, thermal, dynamical characteristics
3. Cement concrete: Cement, admixtures, aggregate, concrete
4. Mixture proportions of cement concrete
5. Steel
6. Asphalt
7. New green materials: Recycling, local production for local consumption, maintenance

Students are required to actively participate in class.
Students are expected to bring their textbook and other necessary materials to every class.

This is useful preparation for Reinforced Concrete, Disaster prevention engineering, and Civil and Environmental Engineering Major Lab/Exercises.[Please confirm course names.]

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Fully explain the features and roles of various construction materials and select appropriate materials on site.
(2) Design mixture proportions for cement concrete and master the process of its manufacture.
(3) Direct reasonable methods for manufacturing cement concrete on site.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Understand the features and roles of various construction materials.
(2) Calculate mixture proportion for cement concrete and understand the process of its manufacture.
(3) Assist in manufacturing cement concrete on site.
